b: Fender has launched the Fusion Series, a limited-edition line aimed at heavier styles. The series debuts with four models that pair high-output humbuckers with noiseless single-coils: the LE Player Fusion Stratocaster HSS, LE Player Fusion Telecaster HH Floyd Rose, LE Player Fusion Baritone Jaguar, and LE Player Fusion Precision Bass HH. Each model has sleek all-black hardware and a 12"-radius ebony fingerboard for clean note bending.
Limited Edition Player Fusion Stratocaster HSS ($1,149.99 USD, £1,049 GBP, €1,249 EUR, $1,999.00 AUD, ¥176,000 JPY)

The Fusion Stratocaster HSS pairs a high-output bridge humbucker with noiseless single-coils in the middle and neck positions. It also has a 12"-radius ebony fingerboard and a 2-point tremolo with black hardware. Available in Black and Olympic Pearl.
Limited Edition Player Fusion Telecaster HH Floyd Rose ($1,399.99 USD, £1,149 GBP, €1,349 EUR, $2,299.00 AUD, ¥192,500 JPY)
The Fusion Telecaster HH Floyd Rose has two high-output humbuckers, an all-black Floyd Rose tremolo system, and a 12"-radius ebony fingerboard. Available in Black and Aura Metallic.
Limited Edition Player Fusion Jaguar Baritone ($1,299.99 USD, £1,049 GBP, €1,249 EUR, $2,199.00 AUD, ¥181,500 JPY)

The Fusion Baritone Jaguar has a 27" scale and is tuned B to B for drop tunings and extended-range playing. Its Jaguar rhythm-circuit control section adds Spin-a-Split wiring via Fender roller pots, which gradually turns the humbuckers into single-coils, along with a TBX tone circuit. It also has high-output humbuckers and a 12"-radius ebony fingerboard. Available in Black and Silverburst.
Limited Edition Player Fusion Precision Bass HH ($1,149.99 USD, £1,149 GBP, €1,349 EUR, $1,999.00 AUD, ¥176,000 JPY)
The Fusion Precision Bass HH has two high-output humbuckers, a thin Jazz Bass neck profile, and a 12"-radius ebony fingerboard. Available in Black and Halo Metallic.
